name: Northam Platinum Holdings Limited
source: CRON 20261121: Northam Platinum Holdings Limited, audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 30 June 2026 (northam.co.za, F2026 AFS page 37): the statement of profit or loss runs Sales revenue, Cost of sales (operating costs, concentrates purchased, refining and other costs, depreciation, change in metal inventory), then Gross profit 14 153 013, and Gross profit IS the printed operating profit. No operating-expenses line exists in the statement, so the stored Operating Expenses figure contradicted the issuer by R80.878 million in F2026 (gross profit less it does not equal the printed operating profit). Row withheld 2026-11-24, all periods, rather than print a number the statement does not contain.

notes: The issuer statement of profit or loss (results presentation, statement of profit or loss) carries no operating expenses line: Revenue less Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit, which the group reports as operating profit. Operating Expenses is therefore empty for FY2026 and FY2025.

Profit Before Tax exceeds Operating Profit because it includes a R2,526.9m reversal of impairment, R1,091.8m investment income and R1,034.4m sundry income, less R1,343.9m finance charges and R222.0m sundry expenditure.
note: Operating Expenses withheld: the audited consolidated statement of profit or loss presents no operating expenses line outside cost of sales. Operating costs, concentrates purchased, refining and other costs, depreciation and the metal inventory movement all sit inside cost of sales. The stored row carried figures that do not appear in that statement (R80.9m of operating expenses against R54.0bn of revenue for F2026). Operating profit as printed equals gross profit.
